# poppkflow

Structured, iterative population PK model development with
[nlmixr2](https://nlmixr2.org). Model development is a loop: specify a
model, fit it, diagnose it, compare it with its parent, decide, and
modify. `poppkflow` supports this loop and records it.

- **Declarative model specifications**
  ([`pk_spec()`](reference/pk_spec.md),
  [`pk_add_iiv()`](reference/pk_edit.md),
  [`pk_add_cov()`](reference/pk_edit.md), …) instead of hand-edited
  model code.
- **A run ledger**: `ledger/runs.csv` (one row per run: lineage, hashes,
  OFV, dOFV against the parent, flags, decision) plus
  `ledger/events.csv` (append-only audit trail) and RDS files per run
  (`models/<run>/fit.rds`, `result.rds`, `spec.rds`, …). Identical runs
  come from a cache.
- **Standard diagnostics, flags and suggestions** for every run.
- **Comparison and decisions with rationale**
  ([`pk_compare()`](reference/pk_compare.md),
  [`pk_decide()`](reference/pk_decide.md)).
- **Covariate screening and stepwise covariate modelling**, robustness
  checks (multiple starts, seeds), bootstrap, VPC, exposure.
- **A report generated from the ledger**
  ([`pk_report()`](reference/pk_report.md)).

## Example

``` r

library(poppkflow)

proj <- pk_project("my_analysis")
pk_covariates(tibble::tribble(
  ~name , ~type         , ~ref,
  "WT"  , "continuous"  , 70  ,
  "CRCL", "continuous"  , 100 ,
  "SEXF", "categorical" , NA
))
dat <- pk_data(system.file("extdata", "example_pk.csv", package = "poppkflow"))
pk_check(dat)

# base model
r1 <- pk_run(pk_spec(ncmt = 2, lag = TRUE, iiv = c("ka", "cl", "v2")),
             note = "Base model", stage = "structural")
pk_diagnostics(r1)

# the data suggest a change: modify the parent and fit the candidate
r2 <- r1 |>
  pk_add_cov("cl", "WT", form = "power", init = 0.75) |>
  pk_inits_from(r1) |>
  pk_run(note = "WT on CL", stage = "covariate")

pk_compare(r1, r2)
pk_decide(r2, "accepted", reason = "dOFV < -6.63 for 1 df; plausible allometric effect")

pk_tree()
pk_history()
```

## Development

``` r

devtools::load_all()
devtools::test()                                 # fast tests with a stub fit function
Sys.setenv(POPPKFLOW_SLOW = "true"); devtools::test()   # also real nlmixr2 fits
```

# Package index

## Project and data

- [`pk_project()`](pk_project.md) [`pk_open()`](pk_project.md)
  [`pk_use()`](pk_project.md) [`pk_current()`](pk_project.md) : Project
  folders and configuration
- [`pk_covariates()`](pk_covariates.md) : Covariate dictionary
- [`pk_data()`](pk_data.md) : Register and read the analysis dataset
- [`pk_check()`](pk_check.md) : Check the analysis dataset
- [`pk_simulate_example()`](pk_simulate_example.md) : Simulate a small
  example dataset

## Model specification

- [`pk_spec()`](pk_spec.md) : Declarative model specification
- [`pk_params()`](pk_params.md) : Structural parameter names of a
  specification
- [`pk_set_structure()`](pk_edit.md) [`pk_add_iiv()`](pk_edit.md)
  [`pk_drop_iiv()`](pk_edit.md) [`pk_set_block()`](pk_edit.md)
  [`pk_drop_block()`](pk_edit.md) [`pk_add_iov()`](pk_edit.md)
  [`pk_set_error()`](pk_edit.md) [`pk_add_cov()`](pk_edit.md)
  [`pk_drop_cov()`](pk_edit.md) [`pk_set_inits()`](pk_edit.md) : Edit a
  model specification
- [`pk_inits_from()`](pk_inits_from.md) : Use the final estimates of a
  run as initial estimates
- [`pk_compile()`](pk_compile.md) [`pk_code()`](pk_compile.md) : Compile
  a specification into an nlmixr2 model
- [`pk_est()`](pk_est.md) : Estimation settings

## Runs and ledger

- [`pk_run()`](pk_run.md) : Fit a model and register it in the ledger
- [`pk_runs()`](pk_runs.md) [`pk_history()`](pk_runs.md)
  [`pk_audit()`](pk_runs.md) [`pk_tree()`](pk_runs.md) : Runs, history,
  audit trail and lineage
- [`pk_get()`](pk_get.md) [`pk_result()`](pk_get.md)
  [`pk_run_ref()`](pk_get.md) : Access a run
- [`pk_params_table()`](pk_params_table.md) : Parameter table of a run
- [`pk_decide()`](pk_decide.md) : Record a decision on a run

## Diagnostics and comparison

- [`pk_diagnostics()`](pk_diagnostics.md) : Standard diagnostics bundle
  for a run
- [`pk_plot_gof()`](pk_plots.md) [`pk_plot_eta()`](pk_plots.md)
  [`pk_plot_eta_cov()`](pk_plots.md) [`pk_plot_ind()`](pk_plots.md) :
  Diagnostic plots
- [`pk_flags()`](pk_flags.md) : Rule-based warnings for a run
- [`pk_suggest()`](pk_suggest.md) : Non-binding suggestions for the next
  modelling step
- [`pk_compare()`](pk_compare.md) [`pk_compare_params()`](pk_compare.md)
  : Compare runs

## Covariates and robustness

- [`pk_screen_covariates()`](pk_screen_covariates.md) : Screen ETAs
  against covariates
- [`pk_scm()`](pk_scm.md) : Stepwise covariate modelling (SCM)
- [`pk_multistart()`](pk_multistart.md) : Search for local minima:
  multiple starting values
- [`pk_repro()`](pk_repro.md) : Reproducibility of the OFV

## Evaluation

- [`pk_bootstrap()`](pk_bootstrap.md) : Non-parametric bootstrap
- [`pk_bootstrap_summary()`](pk_bootstrap_summary.md) : Summary of a
  bootstrap
- [`pk_vpc()`](pk_vpc.md) : Visual predictive check
- [`pk_exposure()`](pk_exposure.md) : Individual exposure and secondary
  parameters
- [`pk_exposure_summary()`](pk_exposure_summary.md) : Summarise exposure
  metrics

## Reporting and migration

- [`pk_report()`](pk_report.md) : Generate the model development report
- [`pk_import_legacy()`](pk_import_legacy.md) : Import existing runs
  into the ledger
